Fortrea was supporting a biotech sponsor in its Phase III global clinical trial for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). With three studies, each enrolling more than 3,000 participants, the sponsor wanted to evaluate its initial spirometry study data by piloting a third-party AI tool.
